name: watch_submariner_median3
comment: CHECK vs Switchboard On-Demand job spec (https://docs.switchboard.xyz) — best-effort per docs/research/03 §2 ('build a Switchboard job per coin, with 2-5 HttpTask sources, a median'), not validated against a live Switchboard oracle in this sandbox (no network). Represents SUBMARINER; the other 9 watch symbols (DAYTONA, GMTMASTER, DATEJUST, ROYALOAK, NAUTILUS, SPEEDMSTR, SANTOS, GSHOCK, TISSOTPRX) get the same job shape with their own reference number substituted — see apps/keeper/src/sources/watches.ts WATCH_REFERENCE. Chrono24 has no public API (see sources/watches.ts fetchChrono24Price) so it is intentionally NOT a task here; only WatchCharts + Collector Crypt feed this job until a compliant Chrono24 source exists. CHECK: the Collector Crypt leg's `divide: [1000000000]` only converts lamports to SOL, not SOL to USD — a real job needs an extra httpTask against Hermes for SOL/USD and a multiplyTask before the median, omitted here for brevity (the keeper-side apps/keeper/src/sources/collectorcrypt.ts does the full conversion). API keys are examples of variable-override names, not real secrets.
